static_traits.name: Zhu Li
static_traits.educational_background: Currently pursuing a fashion design degree
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk to in New York,but tends not to actively seek help for fear of being judged and adding burden
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological issues before;has not yet received psychotherapy;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,able to describe stressors and worries specifically;fairly cooperative but overall negative attitude;thinking often shows catastrophizing and jumping to conclusions;easily occupied by negative Automatic thoughts under exam/project pressure,Sleep disturbed

basic_info.main_problem: Since moving to New York to attend a prestigious fashion design school,I have been having overwhelming thoughts,feeling I will go bankrupt and be unable to succeed academically.These thoughts are especially strong before exams or design projects,with persistent worry about finances and academic performance.
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts have affected my ability to focus on studying and enjoy life in New York, so I am seeking counseling to reduce the impact and improve my focus and life experience.

core_beliefs: I am not capable enough and will fail in the end
My future is uncontrollable and full of risks(will go bankrupt)

special_situations.event: Moved to New York and entered a well-known fashion design institute, facing a competitive environment and high tuition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot excel in a competitive environment and maintain financial stability,it means I have failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying self-soothing and seeking support from friends, but soon retreating again to gritting it out alone and avoiding opening up
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will go bankrupt and never learn anything

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot achieve high scores in exams/projects,I will be expelled and all effort wasted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays up late worrying; forces himself to push tasks forward but finds it hard to concentrate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will fail courses,then head toward bankruptcy and have to drop out

special_situations.event: Tries to talk to friends about own financial and academic worries
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express Anxiety,friends will think I am exaggerating or not understand me,thus affecting the relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding opening up to friends,Reduced socializing to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am making a big deal out of nothing and causing trouble for others

special_situations.event: Reviews some past projects where performance was acceptable or normal feedback was received
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the result is not perfect,it does not count as real ability;good results are just luck
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributing positive performance to luck,denying one's own ability and effort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Doing okay in the past was just luck, and luck will run out

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and supported, while gaining safety and a sense of control in studies and finances
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged or seen as exaggerating; fears failure leading to bankruptcy and dropping out
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of security by reducing exposure and toughing it out alone,avoiding being judged and negated

object_relations.self_representation: An anxious Student worried about being misunderstood and judged
object_relations.object_representation: Others/friends who may blame or not understand oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to seek support from friends or when interpersonal support is mentioned
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously viewing others as potential judges,believing they will find oneself exaggerated or incompetent(Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use gentle affirmation and concretizing Questioning,inviting examples and evidence;keep an even tone,focus on present experience and relational safety,avoid confrontation and judgment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes positive evidence and abilities from one's past projects
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting positive results as 'just luck',to maintain Anticipation of failure and Self-doubt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Distinguishing facts from Interpretation through collaborative inquiry,inviting them to detail effort and skill lists;supportive tone,not blaming,gradually linking emotions and facts.

manifestations: Living alone in New York,adapting to the new city and competitive environment
Worrying about being judged and unwilling to open up to friends
Tending to tough it out alone under pressure
outcomes: Difficulty focusing on studies and engaging in daily activities

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not seeking support from friends,toughing it out alone instead

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing friends will find oneself exaggerated or not understand,thus avoiding opening up

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Limiting one's own expression and action through catastrophizing and predicting the future

positive_force: Performed acceptably in some projects in the past, has some ability to learn and complete tasks
Willing to try challenging negative thoughts and participate in counseling
Has a few friends in New York who could be potential support
negative_force: Prominent cognitive patterns of catastrophizing and predicting the future
Strong Self-doubt,attributing success to luck while negating one's own ability
Worrying about judgment leads to avoiding help-seeking and social contact
Sleep disturbed,further reducing focus and daily functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Intense Anxiety and catastrophic worrying when projects/Exams approaching(such as 'will go bankrupt,will fail,have to drop out')
antecedent: The pressure of adapting to a new city and a competitive academic environment
target_behavior.core_reason: The environmental pressure and economic burden brought by moving to New York and entering a highly competitive academy triggered catastrophic cognition about failure and financial collapse
target_behavior.function: Evades task pressure in the short term, tries to gain a sense of control and prevent worst cases through worry
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty concentrating and engaging in Learning,disrupted sleep,overall Decline in sense of well-being and limited participation in daily activities
